subject: math
cluster: Geometric measurement: understand concepts of volume and relate volume to multiplication and to addition

steps: Volume is the amount of space a solid figure takes up.
It is measured in cubic units.
solution.answer: The space a solid takes up, in cubic units

items.prompt: A box is filled with $8$ unit cubes with no gaps. What is its volume?

steps: So the volume is $8$ cubic units.

items.prompt: What unit is volume measured in?

steps: It is measured in cubic units.

items.prompt: A unit cube has sides of $1$ unit. What is its volume?

steps: A single unit cube has a volume of $1$ cubic unit.

items.prompt: A solid is built from $12$ unit cubes. What is its volume?
Why must the cubes have no gaps when measuring volume?

steps: Gaps would make the count wrong.
The cubes must fully fill the space once.
solution.answer: So the volume count is correct
